about: Where SF's injury crashes happen, by the kind of place a fix acts on: each size_families group's people hurt and KSI people at signalized and unsignalized corners, all-way stops, the High Injury Network, each street class and stress level, school zones, Slow Streets, 20 mph blocks, speed camera corridors, candidate low-traffic cells, night and day, by turn movement, and SF's count of each kind of place.

all_way_stops.how: unsignalized intersections whose stop signs face every block meeting there (a floor: one-way streets miss)
all_way_stops.source: DataSF 4542-gpa3 (stop signs, status L left out), read 2026-11-25

arterial_intersections.how: intersections an arterial or major street meets

hin2022_miles.how: sum of corrected_length_miles over the 2022 HIN's blocks

hin_corners.how: intersections at an end of a 2024 HIN block

hin_miles.how: sum of corrected_length_miles over the 2024 HIN's blocks

intersections.how: nodes where two or more named streets meet

ltn_cell_residential_miles.how: residential street miles inside those cells

ltn_cells.how: candidate low-traffic cells of at least 0.5 miles of street (this script's rule)
ltn_cells.source: DataSF 3psu-pn9h, active surface blocks, read 2026-11-25; SFMTA 2023 draft BCI (data/extract/sfmta-bci/scores.json, read 2026-10-04)

multilane_arterial_collector_miles.how: arterial, major and collector miles with 2 or more off-peak lanes (SFMTA MTA.CTA_trafficlanes LANES_OP)
multilane_arterial_collector_miles.source: DataSF 3psu-pn9h, active surface blocks, read 2026-11-25; SFMTA MTA.CTA_trafficlanes read 2026-11-25

schools.how: active schools, every entity type but Preschool; a 500 ft zone each

signalized_arterial_intersections.how: intersections an arterial or major street meets, with a signal
signalized_arterial_intersections.source: DataSF 3psu-pn9h, active surface blocks, read 2026-11-25; DataSF ybh5-27n2, types CALTRANS, CALTRANS (BY CONTRACTOR CONSORTIUM GLC), SIGNAL, SIGNAL (CONTRACTOR MAINTAINED), read 2026-11-25

signalized_intersections.source: DataSF ybh5-27n2, types CALTRANS, CALTRANS (BY CONTRACTOR CONSORTIUM GLC), SIGNAL, SIGNAL (CONTRACTOR MAINTAINED), read 2026-11-25

slip_lanes.how: no city dataset of slip lanes (channelized right turns) was found in the DataSF catalog on 2026-11-25

slow_street_miles.how: miles of Implemented Slow Street blocks (hkz3-itiu, last edited 2024-01-18)

speed_camera_sites.how: speed camera sites placed on a block (the street lane's rule)

stop_controlled_intersections.how: unsignalized intersections with at least one stop sign
stop_controlled_intersections.source: DataSF 4542-gpa3 (stop signs, status L left out), read 2026-11-25

surface_miles.how: every active surface street mile (no freeway, ramp or class 0)

two_way_or_partial_stops.how: unsignalized intersections with some but not all approaches stopped
two_way_or_partial_stops.source: DataSF 4542-gpa3 (stop signs, status L left out), read 2026-11-25

uncontrolled_intersections.how: intersections with no signal and no stop sign
uncontrolled_intersections.source: DataSF 4542-gpa3 (stop signs, status L left out), read 2026-11-25

unposted_25_miles.how: surface miles with speedlimit 0, the 25 mph default

unsignalized_arterial_intersections.how: intersections an arterial or major street meets, with no signal
unsignalized_arterial_intersections.source: DataSF 3psu-pn9h, active surface blocks, read 2026-11-25; DataSF ybh5-27n2, types CALTRANS, CALTRANS (BY CONTRACTOR CONSORTIUM GLC), SIGNAL, SIGNAL (CONTRACTOR MAINTAINED), read 2026-11-25

unsignalized_intersections.source: DataSF 3psu-pn9h, active surface blocks, read 2026-11-25; DataSF ybh5-27n2, types CALTRANS, CALTRANS (BY CONTRACTOR CONSORTIUM GLC), SIGNAL, SIGNAL (CONTRACTOR MAINTAINED), read 2026-11-25
